race.comment: OOHLALOUVRE (1) has returned in career-best touch this prep, having won a CL2 here two back before missing by a neck in CL4 last time. Has to lug the weight with the drop in grade but she's going to good to ignore. CRYPTIC BEAUTY (6) is well placed back from mid-week grade after a narrow first-up defeat at Doomben and has the right track-and-trip credentials to improve second-up. IMPACT ZONE (3) was only run down late at the Gold Coast and comes back in trip with fitness on his side. Not taking lightly. MOAKSUN (5) put it all together stylishly here last start to win well. From the inside draw he can run another big race.
